$description: W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG 2025.10) Format Specification for Medical Pedagogy & Clinical Ecosystem (@ui-ux v1.5 - FB-01 -> FB-44 / LOCK-14)

page.$description: 60% Dominant Canvas - Pure white background for A4 PDF print and clean reading surfaces

webapp.$description: 60% Dominant Canvas - Porcelain slate background for long-session HTML5 Quiz/Flashcard apps

container.$description: 30% Secondary Structural Surface - Soft clinical blue for Python flowcharts (1150px) and summary boxes (FB-01)

card.$description: 30% Secondary Structural Surface - Subtle neutral container for secondary callouts and metadata

primary.$description: Pure Academic Black body text - Contrast ratio 18.88:1 on #FFFFFF (exceeds WCAG 2.2 AAA 7.0:1 requirement, FB-02)

secondary.$description: High-contrast slate for captions, table subheaders, and secondary annotations (Contrast ratio 10.3:1 on #FFFFFF)

on-structural.$description: White text on deep structural navy headers (#1E3A5F) - Contrast ratio 11.6:1

navy.$description: 30% Structural Brand Navy for H1/H2 accents, table headers, and taskbar navigation

border.$description: Clean structural divider for tables, cards, and flowchart nodes

accent.$description: <= 10% Accent Color Budget strictly reserved for high-value clinical signals (FB-03, FB-06)

danger.$description: Clinical Red Flag / Contraindication / Critical Warning (Contrast ratio 6.4:1 on #FFFFFF)

success.$description: Clinical Target / Correct SBA Option / Safe Threshold (Contrast ratio 5.5:1 on #FFFFFF)

caution.$description: Near-Miss Discriminator / Dose Adjustment / Exam Note Highlight (Contrast ratio 5.0:1 on #FFFFFF)

body-size.$description: Mandatory A4 lecture body font size (FB-02)

diagram-effective-size.$description: Mandatory effective font size on A4 paper for both inline Vector SVG (viewBox 630px, 12pt) and Python PIL Flowcharts (1150px canvas, >=28-29px font = 12pt A4, FB-43)

table-size.$description: Compact yet legible table cell font size for clinical comparison matrices

h2-size.$description: Major section heading scale (concise <= 8-10 words, FB-43)

body.$description: Optimal reading line-height for Vietnamese diacritics on A4

table.$description: Compact line-height for structured tables with .td-line blocks

bold-ratio-min.$description: Minimum recommended in-sentence bold keyword ratio (8%), exempting 100% of structural bullet/table lead-in labels (FB-27, FB-43)

bold-ratio-target-max.$description: Golden upper target for in-sentence bold keyword ratio (15%) (FB-27, FB-43)

bold-ratio-hard-cap.$description: Hard ceiling (18%) on in-sentence bold words after excluding structural lead-in headings (FB-27, FB-43)

bold-span-max-words.$description: Maximum words per in-sentence <b>/<strong> tag while strictly preserving compound Vietnamese medical terms intact (FB-27, FB-43)

h2-heading-max-words.$description: Maximum words for H2 section headings to ensure instant memorability (FB-43)

bullet-label-max-words.$description:
Maximum words for left-edge bullet lead-in labels
  • Label: (FB-43)

lecture-core-proposition-target.$description: 80% - 90% recall of unique deduplicated clinical concepts (Vid U Slide U PNT) via inline micro-causal parenthetical compression (FB-40, FB-43)

true-academic-keyword-density.$description: 10% - 15% true academic keyword words per 100 words of text (UMLS/MeSH/NBME standard, never 70/100 words, FB-43)

lecture-page-min.$description: Minimum A4 pages for lecture PDF (FB-10)

lecture-page-max.$description: Strict hard ceiling <= 9 A4 pages (Compact 4-5, Standard 5-7, Comprehensive 7-9 pages) via cross-source deduplication & micro-causal compression (FB-43)

flashcard-min-count.$description: Minimum flashcards per deck covering 100% lecture + Vid >> Slide >> PNT expansion (FB-32)

flashcard-max-count.$description: Standard upper bound for flashcards (flexible up to 100 for long lessons, FB-32)

quiz-min-question-count.$description: Minimum SBA questions per quiz (flexible upper bound >= 40 per FB-32)

max-key-to-avg-char-ratio.$description: Maximum allowed character ratio between the correct option and the mean of 3 distractors (FB-30)

max-key-to-max-distractor-char-ratio.$description: Maximum allowed character ratio between the correct option and the longest distractor (FB-30)

max-option-spread-char-ratio.$description: Maximum allowed character ratio between the longest and shortest option in a question (FB-30)

max-longest-is-key-rate.$description: Strict hard cap (<= 10% of total questions N >= 40, i.e., at most 4/40 questions) on how often the correct answer can be the longest option by character count (FB-30, FB-44 / LOCK-14)

accent-hard-cap.$description: Maximum 10% accent color coverage across document elements (FB-03, FB-06)

flowchart-width-px.$description: Standard high-DPI width (1150px) for Python PIL summary flowcharts with >=28-29px font (= 12pt on A4, FB-01, FB-43)

svg-viewbox-width-px.$description: 1:1 A4 printable width (167mm = 473.4pt = 630px @ 96dpi) for inline SVG diagrams so font-size=12pt renders at true 12pt without downscaling (FB-43)
